description.subtitle: Puma 750ml Training Water Bottle - Black
description.intro: The Puma Training Core 750 ml bottle is designed to always have water at hand during training, matches and sports activities. Its 750 ml format combines a handy design with a screw cap and push-pull spout that makes it easy to drink quickly during breaks.
key_benefits: Hydration during training: Its format allows water to be available during sports sessions and matches.
Quick use: The push-pull spout makes it easy to drink directly from the bottle during breaks.
Comfortable handling: Its practical design allows it to be easily held and used while training.
Quantity control: The lateral measurement scale allows you to check the volume of liquid contained in the bottle.

source.subtitle: Botellín de agua para entrenamiento Puma de 750 ml - negro
source.intro: El botellín Puma Training Core 750 ml está diseñado para tener el agua siempre a mano durante entrenamientos, partidos y actividad deportiva. Su formato de 750 ml combina un diseño manejable con una tapa de rosca y boquilla push-pull que facilita beber rápidamente durante las pausas.
key_benefits: Hidratación durante el entrenamiento: Su formato permite disponer de agua durante sesiones deportivas y partidos.
Uso rápido: La boquilla push-pull facilita beber directamente del botellín durante las pausas.
Manejo cómodo: Su diseño práctico permite sujetarlo y utilizarlo fácilmente mientras entrenas.
Control de la cantidad: La escala de medición lateral permite consultar el volumen de líquido contenido en el botellín.
